# Momentra (momentra)

> Angular 22+ date and time component library: date input, date picker, time picker, date-time picker, date-time input, date range picker and inline calendars. Standalone components, signals, OnPush, Reactive and template-driven forms, pluggable date adapters (native Date, date-fns, Luxon), Intl-based localization, and theming through CSS custom properties (`--mtr-*`) with light, dark and auto themes.

Key facts for code generation:

- Install: `npm i @momentra/angular @angular/cdk`. No global stylesheet to import; component styles are encapsulated.
- Configure once: `provideMomentra({ theme: 'auto', locale: 'en-US' })` in `bootstrapApplication` providers.
- Components are standalone; import the class (e.g. `DatePickerComponent`) into your component's `imports`.
- Selectors use the `mtr-` prefix: `mtr-date-input`, `mtr-date-picker`, `mtr-time-picker`, `mtr-datetime-picker`, `mtr-datetime-input`, `mtr-date-range-picker`, `mtr-calendar`, `mtr-infinite-calendar`, `mtr-multiview-calendar`, `mtr-month-picker`, `mtr-year-picker`, `mtr-decade-picker`.
- Values are two-way via `[(value)]` (signal model) or `formControl` / `ngModel`. With the default adapter the value type is `Date`.
- Always pass `ariaLabel` (or associate a `<label>`) so the field has an accessible name.
- Theme: `theme` input per component (`'light' | 'dark' | 'auto'`), or set the global `MomentraSettings.theme` signal at runtime.
- Styling: override `--mtr-*` custom properties on `:root` (popups render in the CDK overlay, so ancestors other than `:root`/`body` do not reach them). Never target internal `.mtr-*` classes or use `::ng-deep`; use `cellTemplate` for custom day content.
- Date adapters: `@momentra/angular/date-fns` (`provideMomentraDateFns(config)`) and `@momentra/angular/luxon` (`provideMomentraLuxon(config)`) are optional secondary entry points that replace `provideMomentra`.

## Docs

- [Documentation site](https://oscarandrespabonestrella.github.io/momentra/): live demos and API tables for every component
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@momentra/angular): `@momentra/angular`
- [Full documentation in one file](https://oscarandrespabonestrella.github.io/momentra/llms-full.txt): README plus every guide below, concatenated (also at `node_modules/@momentra/angular/llms-full.txt`)
- [Component APIs](https://github.com/oscarandrespabonestrella/momentra/blob/main/docs/components.md): inputs, outputs and methods of every component, plus global configuration
- [Styling and themes](https://github.com/oscarandrespabonestrella/momentra/blob/main/docs/styling-and-themes.md): themes, every `--mtr-*` custom property with light/dark defaults
- [Localization](https://github.com/oscarandrespabonestrella/momentra/blob/main/docs/localization.md): locales, formats, first day of week, labels
- [Dates and time zones](https://github.com/oscarandrespabonestrella/momentra/blob/main/docs/dates-and-time-zones.md): how values are represented and compared
- [Date adapters](https://github.com/oscarandrespabonestrella/momentra/blob/main/docs/date-adapters.md): native, date-fns, Luxon, writing your own
- [Validation](https://github.com/oscarandrespabonestrella/momentra/blob/main/docs/validation.md): `MomentraValidators`, min/max, disabled dates, error messages
- [Accessibility](https://github.com/oscarandrespabonestrella/momentra/blob/main/docs/accessibility.md): keyboard map, ARIA, focus behaviour
